# Reproduce m2c on `byteidx` — benchmark function synthetic:byteidx:gcc2.7.2kmc.
set -euo pipefail

# m2c checkout (https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c); the benchmark pins commit 94098d4:
#   git clone https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c && git -C m2c checkout 94098d4de68c2fcc13fb8cf1096a1520eb171abe
M2C_PATH='/path/to/m2c'

# The benchmark's objdump→GNU-as normalization of this function's disassembly (m2c cannot
# read raw objdump), including the jump-table/const data sections recovered from the target
# object — the exact text the benchmark fed m2c.
cat > in.s <<'ASM_INPUT'
glabel byteidx
    addu	$a0, $a0, $a1
    jr	$ra
    lbu	$v0, 0($a0)
    nop
ASM_INPUT

# (This function ran with NO context header — the benchmark fed m2c the assembly alone.)

args=(
  --target mips-gcc-c     # ISA + compiler dialect (selects m2c's code-shape assumptions)
  --function byteidx      # the symbol to decompile from in.s
  --no-cache              # bypass m2c's on-disk cache — always a fresh run
)
python3 "$M2C_PATH/m2c.py" "${args[@]}" in.s

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduce asmlift on `byteidx` — benchmark function synthetic:byteidx:gcc2.7.2kmc.
set -euo pipefail

# asmlift checkout — run `pnpm install` there once, with this function's toolchain available
# (`pnpm bench setup` fetches bench-owned toolchains + pinned project checkouts;
# apps/benchmark/README lists the env-var overrides; .github/workflows/benchmark.yml shows a
# complete from-scratch setup):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

# ── Step 1: scoring inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Builds this function's target object (content-cached) and writes a decomp.yaml whose compile
# command is the benchmark's own toolchain invocation — what --score-against compiles with.
# (progress goes to stderr so the script's stdout stays purely the decompiled source)
pnpm --dir "$ASMLIFT_PATH" bench target synthetic:byteidx:gcc2.7.2kmc --out "$PWD" 1>&2

# ── Step 2: the input the benchmark fed asmlift, verbatim ────────────────────
# The exact `objdump -d --no-show-raw-insn` text.
cat > in.asm <<'ASM_INPUT'

target.o:     file format elf32-tradbigmips


Disassembly of section .text:

00000000 <byteidx>:
   0:	addu	a0,a0,a1
   4:	jr	ra
   8:	lbu	v0,0(a0)
   c:	nop

# The target object's objdump -s -r -t dump — the data sections (jump tables, anonymous
# constants) the text-only disassembly lacks; the benchmark recovered them from the object.
cat > dump.txt <<'DUMP_INPUT'

target.o:     file format elf32-tradbigmips

SYMBOL TABLE:
00000000 l    df *ABS*	00000000 /host-tmp/asmlift-mgcc-ref-3bae94321a85d4ab/ref.c
00000000 l     O .text	00000000 gcc2_compiled.
00000000 l    d  .text	00000000 .text
00000000 l    d  .data	00000000 .data
00000000 l    d  .bss	00000000 .bss
00000000 l    d  .reginfo	00000000 .reginfo
00000000 l    d  .note	00000000 .note
00000000 l    d  .comment	00000000 .comment
00000000 g     F .text	0000000c byteidx

Contents of section .reginfo:

Contents of section .note:

Contents of section .comment:
 0000 00474343 3a202847 4e552920 322e372e  .GCC: (GNU) 2.7.
 0010 3200                                 2.
DUMP_INPUT

# ── Step 3: decompile + benchmark-grade scoring ──────────────────────────────
args=(
  in.asm                  # input: the disassembly text above
  --target gcc2.7.2kmc    # frontend + target description (ISA, calling convention, compiler idioms)
  --name byteidx          # the symbol to decompile (multi-function input selects by name)

# the checkout's own asmlift bin (pnpm links it; it runs through the repo's pinned tsx)
"$ASMLIFT_PATH/node_modules/.bin/asmlift" "${args[@]}"

# Reproduce asmlift on `fcmp` — benchmark function synthetic:fcmp:gcc2.7.2kmc.
set -euo pipefail

# asmlift checkout — run `pnpm install` there once, with this function's toolchain available
# (`pnpm bench setup` fetches bench-owned toolchains + pinned project checkouts;
# apps/benchmark/README lists the env-var overrides; .github/workflows/benchmark.yml shows a
# complete from-scratch setup):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

# ── Step 1: scoring inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Builds this function's target object (content-cached) and writes a decomp.yaml whose compile
# command is the benchmark's own toolchain invocation — what --score-against compiles with.
# (progress goes to stderr so the script's stdout stays purely the decompiled source)
pnpm --dir "$ASMLIFT_PATH" bench target synthetic:fcmp:gcc2.7.2kmc --out "$PWD" 1>&2

# ── Step 2: the input the benchmark fed asmlift, verbatim ────────────────────
# The exact `objdump -d --no-show-raw-insn` text.
cat > in.asm <<'ASM_INPUT'

target.o:     file format elf32-tradbigmips


Disassembly of section .text:

00000000 <fcmp>:
   0:	c.lt.s	$f14,$f12
	...
   c:	bc1t	18 <fcmp+0x18>
  10:	li	v0,1
  14:	move	v0,zero
  18:	jr	ra
  1c:	nop
ASM_INPUT

# The target object's objdump -s -r -t dump — the data sections (jump tables, anonymous
# constants) the text-only disassembly lacks; the benchmark recovered them from the object.
cat > dump.txt <<'DUMP_INPUT'

target.o:     file format elf32-tradbigmips

SYMBOL TABLE:
00000000 l    df *ABS*	00000000 /host-tmp/asmlift-mgcc-ref-a65615126cbb723e/ref.c
00000000 l     O .text	00000000 gcc2_compiled.
00000000 l    d  .text	00000000 .text
00000000 l    d  .data	00000000 .data
00000000 l    d  .bss	00000000 .bss
00000000 l    d  .reginfo	00000000 .reginfo
00000000 l    d  .note	00000000 .note
00000000 l    d  .comment	00000000 .comment
00000000 g     F .text	00000020 fcmp


Contents of section .text:
 0000 460c703c 00000000 00000000 45010002  F.p<........E...
 0010 24020001 00001021 03e00008 00000000  $......!........
Contents of section .reginfo:
 0000 80000004 00000000 00005000 00000000  ..........P.....
 0010 00000000 00000000                    ........        
Contents of section .note:
 0000 00000008 00000000 00000001 30312e30  ............01.0
 0010 31000000                             1...            
Contents of section .comment:
 0000 00474343 3a202847 4e552920 322e372e  .GCC: (GNU) 2.7.
 0010 3200                                 2.
DUMP_INPUT

# ── Step 3: decompile + benchmark-grade scoring ──────────────────────────────
args=(
  in.asm                  # input: the disassembly text above
  --target gcc2.7.2kmc    # frontend + target description (ISA, calling convention, compiler idioms)
  --name fcmp             # the symbol to decompile (multi-function input selects by name)
  --asm-data dump.txt     # the data sections above (jump-table/const recovery)
  --config decomp.yaml    # the compile command from step 1
  --score-against target.o # rank candidate variants, objdiff-score each; exit 0 only on byte-exact

# the checkout's own asmlift bin (pnpm links it; it runs through the repo's pinned tsx)
"$ASMLIFT_PATH/node_modules/.bin/asmlift" "${args[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduce m2c on `fcmp` — benchmark function synthetic:fcmp:ido7.1.
set -euo pipefail

# m2c checkout (https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c); the benchmark pins commit 94098d4:
#   git clone https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c && git -C m2c checkout 94098d4de68c2fcc13fb8cf1096a1520eb171abe
M2C_PATH='/path/to/m2c'

# The benchmark's objdump→GNU-as normalization of this function's disassembly (m2c cannot
# read raw objdump), including the jump-table/const data sections recovered from the target
# object — the exact text the benchmark fed m2c.
cat > in.s <<'ASM_INPUT'
glabel fcmp
    c.lt.s	$f14, $f12
    move	$v0, $zero
    bc1f	.L14
    nop
    li	$v0, 1
.L14:
    jr	$ra
    nop
    nop
ASM_INPUT

# (This function ran with NO context header — the benchmark fed m2c the assembly alone.)

args=(
  --target mips-ido-c     # ISA + compiler dialect (selects m2c's code-shape assumptions)
  --function fcmp         # the symbol to decompile from in.s
  --no-cache              # bypass m2c's on-disk cache — always a fresh run
)
python3 "$M2C_PATH/m2c.py" "${args[@]}" in.s

# Reproduce asmlift on `mulc` — benchmark function synthetic:mulc:gcc2.7.2kmc.
set -euo pipefail

# asmlift checkout — run `pnpm install` there once, with this function's toolchain available
# (`pnpm bench setup` fetches bench-owned toolchains + pinned project checkouts;
# apps/benchmark/README lists the env-var overrides; .github/workflows/benchmark.yml shows a
# complete from-scratch setup):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

# ── Step 1: scoring inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Builds this function's target object (content-cached) and writes a decomp.yaml whose compile
# command is the benchmark's own toolchain invocation — what --score-against compiles with.
# (progress goes to stderr so the script's stdout stays purely the decompiled source)
pnpm --dir "$ASMLIFT_PATH" bench target synthetic:mulc:gcc2.7.2kmc --out "$PWD" 1>&2

# ── Step 2: the input the benchmark fed asmlift, verbatim ────────────────────
# The exact `objdump -d --no-show-raw-insn` text.
cat > in.asm <<'ASM_INPUT'

target.o:     file format elf32-tradbigmips


Disassembly of section .text:

00000000 <mulc>:
   0:	sll	v0,a0,0x2
   4:	addu	v0,v0,a0
   8:	jr	ra
   c:	sll	v0,v0,0x1
ASM_INPUT

# The target object's objdump -s -r -t dump — the data sections (jump tables, anonymous
# constants) the text-only disassembly lacks; the benchmark recovered them from the object.
cat > dump.txt <<'DUMP_INPUT'

target.o:     file format elf32-tradbigmips

SYMBOL TABLE:
00000000 l    df *ABS*	00000000 /host-tmp/asmlift-mgcc-ref-554a87e2db088449/ref.c
00000000 l     O .text	00000000 gcc2_compiled.
00000000 l    d  .text	00000000 .text
00000000 l    d  .data	00000000 .data
00000000 l    d  .bss	00000000 .bss
00000000 l    d  .reginfo	00000000 .reginfo
00000000 l    d  .note	00000000 .note
00000000 l    d  .comment	00000000 .comment
00000000 g     F .text	00000010 mulc


Contents of section .text:
 0000 00041080 00441021 03e00008 00021040  .....D.!.......@
Contents of section .reginfo:
 0000 80000014 00000000 00000000 00000000  ................
 0010 00000000 00000000                    ........        
Contents of section .note:
 0000 00000008 00000000 00000001 30312e30  ............01.0
 0010 31000000                             1...            
Contents of section .comment:
 0000 00474343 3a202847 4e552920 322e372e  .GCC: (GNU) 2.7.
 0010 3200                                 2.
DUMP_INPUT

# ── Step 3: decompile + benchmark-grade scoring ──────────────────────────────
args=(
  in.asm                  # input: the disassembly text above
  --target gcc2.7.2kmc    # frontend + target description (ISA, calling convention, compiler idioms)
  --name mulc             # the symbol to decompile (multi-function input selects by name)
  --asm-data dump.txt     # the data sections above (jump-table/const recovery)
  --config decomp.yaml    # the compile command from step 1
  --score-against target.o # rank candidate variants, objdiff-score each; exit 0 only on byte-exact
)
# the checkout's own asmlift bin (pnpm links it; it runs through the repo's pinned tsx)
"$ASMLIFT_PATH/node_modules/.bin/asmlift" "${args[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduce m2c on `mulc` — benchmark function synthetic:mulc:ido7.1.
set -euo pipefail

# m2c checkout (https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c); the benchmark pins commit 94098d4:
#   git clone https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c && git -C m2c checkout 94098d4de68c2fcc13fb8cf1096a1520eb171abe
M2C_PATH='/path/to/m2c'

# The benchmark's objdump→GNU-as normalization of this function's disassembly (m2c cannot
# read raw objdump), including the jump-table/const data sections recovered from the target
# object — the exact text the benchmark fed m2c.
cat > in.s <<'ASM_INPUT'
glabel mulc
    sll	$v0, $a0, 0x2
    addu	$v0, $v0, $a0
    jr	$ra
    sll	$v0, $v0, 0x1
ASM_INPUT

# (This function ran with NO context header — the benchmark fed m2c the assembly alone.)

args=(
  --target mips-ido-c     # ISA + compiler dialect (selects m2c's code-shape assumptions)
  --function mulc         # the symbol to decompile from in.s
  --no-cache              # bypass m2c's on-disk cache — always a fresh run
)
python3 "$M2C_PATH/m2c.py" "${args[@]}" in.s

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduce m2c on `shru` — benchmark function synthetic:shru:mwcc_242_81.
set -euo pipefail

# m2c checkout (https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c); the benchmark pins commit 94098d4:
#   git clone https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c && git -C m2c checkout 94098d4de68c2fcc13fb8cf1096a1520eb171abe
M2C_PATH='/path/to/m2c'

# The benchmark's objdump→GNU-as normalization of this function's disassembly (m2c cannot
# read raw objdump), including the jump-table/const data sections recovered from the target
# object — the exact text the benchmark fed m2c.
cat > in.s <<'ASM_INPUT'
glabel shru
    srw     r3,r3,r4
    blr
ASM_INPUT

# (This function ran with NO context header — the benchmark fed m2c the assembly alone.)

args=(
  --target ppc-mwcc-c     # ISA + compiler dialect (selects m2c's code-shape assumptions)
  --function shru         # the symbol to decompile from in.s
  --no-cache              # bypass m2c's on-disk cache — always a fresh run
)
python3 "$M2C_PATH/m2c.py" "${args[@]}" in.s
